source.title: Derry Journal, 8 January 1934, p. 8 ("Derry municipal elections: the nominations; no contests in any ward")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed (Derry Journal, 8 January 1934: no contest in any ward)

note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation, with a third West Ward seat vacant through the death of Michael M'Menamin; nominations Friday 5 January 1934. All eleven nominees, five Nationalists and six Unionists, were returned unopposed and there was no poll (Derry Journal, 8 January 1934). No party labels are printed against the names. M'Corkell was Mayor. Returned unopposed.
